correctness.rationale: For any ideal I of E_M, its support union S contains independent squares e_i^2; comparing dimensions gives I=span(e_i:i in S). Exact block GL counts give the cut probability. Every pair of distinct singleton row/column events forces at least 2n-3 zeros; all cuts of sizes 2 through n-2 have total conditional probability O_q(n^2 q^{-2n+4}). This proves the limit and ideal-dimension split for every fixed prime power q. The 7-case checker independently enumerates exact finite matrix spaces.

value.rationale: The natural labelled full-rank evolution-algebra ensemble has a sharp algebraic simplicity statistic not supplied by prior structural graph equivalences. Exact coordinate-ideal classification and prescribed-cut probabilities accompany a field-dependent sharp leading term, and the typical nonsimple ideal is shown to have dimension 1 or codimension 1 with equal conditional weights. This is materially more informative than an almost-sure graph connectivity statement.
